name: Badge
purpose: Display compact numeric values such as counts, tallies, and score changes.
intent: Provide a small, non-interactive visual indicator that supports fast scanning without adding action or status-label semantics.

anatomy.description: Single visual container for the badge value.

children.description: Visible badge content. Intended for short numeric values.

tone.description: Visual tone for badge emphasis or semantic meaning.

label.description: The count in words, such as "3 unread messages". Rendered as visually hidden text that screen readers read in place of the visible value, which is aria-hidden.

ariaLabel.description: Deprecated alias for label, rendered the same way. label wins when both are set.

requirements: Set label when the visible value is ambiguous.
Ensure color contrast meets requirements for all tones.

textAlternative.mapsTo: visually hidden text; the visible value gets aria-hidden
textAlternative.why: The span has no role, and ARIA prohibits aria-label on the generic role, so screen readers may ignore it.
textAlternative.useWhen: The words beside the badge don't say what the number counts.

behaviorRules: Do not add hover, press, active, loading, or disabled states.
Apply data-tone equal to the selected tone.
Forward other span attributes (id, title, data-*, native aria-*) to the root span.
compositionRules: Badge may appear inside navigation, tables, lists, cards, buttons, and summaries.
Use Tooltip if additional visible explanation is needed.
Use Tag or Label for text classification instead of Badge.
Use Button or IconButton for actions.
contentRules: Content should be short and numeric.
Recommended content length is 1 to 4 characters.
Do not use long words or phrases.
themeRules: Must work in light and dark themes.
Tone colors must use semantic CSS variables.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo for the exported component.
No hardcoded colors, spacing, radius, or typography when tokens exist.
dont: Do not use for long text labels.
Do not use for status labels requiring explanation.
Do not add loading, disabled, hover, or active states.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports label as visually hidden text with the visible value aria-hidden; ariaLabel is a deprecated alias.
Uses tokenized typography, spacing, radius, and colors.
Storybook includes Playground, Variants, and Examples.
Tests cover children, default tone, selected tone, label and the deprecated ariaLabel, attribute forwarding, className, and radius token usage.
knownLimitations: No non-numeric content guidance beyond recommended limits.
futureEnhancements: Icon support if a real use case emerges
